sandra_customer: Hey team — we're seeing a bunch of requests from our integration suddenly go to us-west instead of eu-central. Billing spike + 200ms extra p99 latency. Started around 10:20 UTC. Can you help investigate?

alex_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a curl repro and a request id from one of those hits? Any chance multiple region fields are set?

sandra_customer: here's an anonymized example: 

curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=eu-central" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Client-Region: " \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

request-id: r-20250321-8345

alex_support: Interesting — I notice the client is sending an empty X-Client-Region header (value is blank). Our router's precedence: header > query param > auth claim. If header is present but empty, it currently treats it as present and wins, which can cause a fallback to nearest-pop or default region.

maria_infra: Pulling logs for r-20250321-8345... attaching excerpt: 
```
router: recv req r-20250321-8345 src=1.2.3.4 headers={Authorization, Content-Type, X-Client-Region}
auth: parsed tenant t-acme, region_claim=eu-central
router: header X-Client-Region="" -> interpreted non-null
router: region selection -> header precedence -> selected edge us-west-2
proxy: routed to edge us-west-2 (latency 42ms to pop)
```

maria_infra: So the header is present but empty string. That caused the router to prefer it over the query param. The query param sits in the URL (?region=eu-central) but lost because of header precedence.

alex_support: Does the client library ever send empty headers intentionally?

sandra_customer: Our integrator uses an SDK that sets X-Client-Region to client.region || '' (empty string) — they didn't realize it. We can patch them but wondering if we should treat empty headers as absent on our side.

kevin_sre: This is a classic precedence + empty-value bug. Quick mitigation: treat empty/whitespace-only region headers as not provided. I'll open a router config PR to normalize headers (trim + drop empty). That will avoid silent misroutes.

kevin_sre: Proposed patch diff sketch: 
```
// pseudocode
regionHeader = headers.get('X-Client-Region')
if regionHeader != null {
  regionHeader = regionHeader.trim()
  if regionHeader == '' { regionHeader = null }
}
// then proceed with precedence logic
```

acme_integration_bot: audit: 12 requests with empty X-Client-Region detected in last 15m for tenant t-acme, avg p99 latency +180ms vs normal, billable token counts unaffected but routing charges differ by region.

alex_support: Thanks @kevin_sre — can you ETA the router change? Also adding a short-term support tweak: we can whitelist tenant t-acme to force query-param precedence until router fix deploys.

kevin_sre: ETA ~2 hours for canary config update and 6 hours for global rollout (small safe change). Whitelist for t-acme done (will validate).

maria_infra: After whitelist, I see new hits for r-20250321-8345 rerouted to eu-central as expected. Repro now: 
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=eu-central" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Client-Region: " \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
router: selected edge eu-central-1 (because query param honored for tenant whitelist)

sandra_customer: Confirmed on our side — requests back to eu, latency normalized. Thanks for fast turnaround! :rocket:

alex_support: Follow-ups: (1) please have the integrator stop sending empty header values; (2) we'll deploy the header normalization so this doesn't recur; (3) I'll open a billing ticket to review any region-differential charges during the window.

kevin_sre: Filed infra-1234 (router header normalization). I'll link to this thread and cc eng-oncall.

sandra_customer: Appreciated. If you can also share the rollout ETA we can inform our customers.

kevin_sre: Canary started in us-west-2 for non-critical tenants (no impact). Global rollout ETA 6 hours. I'll post here once done.

alex_support: Closing customer-facing loop: I'll send a short summary and the temporary whitelist workaround. If anything else crops up ping this thread. :thumbsup:
